name: Costco
fiscalYearEnd: Sunday nearest August 31 (FY2025 ended 2025-08-31; FY2026 ended 2026-08-30)
description: Costco runs membership-only warehouse stores that sell bulk groceries and merchandise, plus gas, pharmacy and travel, at very low markups. The company earns about half of its operating profit from annual membership fees: $5.3B of about $10.4B FY2025 operating income, with the merchandise itself sold near break-even after costs. Membership renewal is the key number: 92.3% in the US and Canada and 89.8% worldwide at the end of FY2025, with 81 million paid members (up 6.3%) and 38.7 million higher-fee Executive members. Its Kirkland Signature private label carries higher margins than national brands. E-commerce was about 7% of net sales.
